reviewScope: The complete shared source collection was reviewed once across its country albums. reviewedImageCount refers to that collection; omissions for this album include frames used in the other country album. Selected sources are exclusive across these four albums.
dateSource: Camera-local EXIF timestamps with the original recorded UTC offset. Pixel filenames can use UTC and are not used as calendar dates. The owner confirmed Europe_26 as the source for Portugal and Finland; July 2026 dates are preserved.
locationNotes: Countries and sites use original GPS, visual landmarks, readable signs and chronological context; exact GPS coordinates are not copied into the album or manifest.
Date and location labels follow the photographs, not a planned itinerary. No itinerary was present or used.
Transit photographs in India, the UAE and the air are outside these country albums. A few stale GPS fixes are superseded by visible landmarks and adjacent frames.

All 451 Europe 2024 and 526 Europe 2026 stills were reviewed in thirteen contact sheets. The 205 shortlisted candidates received a larger 500-pixel review; the four covers were also opened at 1500 pixels.
Originals, videos, source archives, private documents and review sheets stay outside the website and R2. Only selected metadata-free WebP derivatives are uploaded.
criteria: Create one album per country, keeping cities, days and locations as chronological sections within that album.
Prefer clear, distinct scenery, architecture, interiors, food, wildlife and daily life; compare similar bursts and avoid padding short days.
Count each cover once in the album and its actual capture day; never repeat the cover in a gallery.
Preserve framing and colour, correct EXIF orientation and omit EXIF/XMP from published WebP copies, at quality 84 and at most 2000 pixels on the long edge or 2400 for covers.
Local people, crowds and incidental visitors are allowed. Selected people scenes are listed for review without identifying or matching faces.
omissionReasons: Frames used in the other country album are recorded explicitly and are not duplicated here.
Near-identical bursts, repeated viewpoints, blurred or obstructed frames, weak compositions and most posed portraits were omitted after visual comparison.
Conference presentation slides, certificates, schedules, receipts, hotel-room records, menus and routine travel logistics were omitted.
Videos and long flight-window sequences are outside these still-photo albums.
